title: FLORO: A Multimodal Geospatial Foundation Model for Ecological Remote Sensing Across Sensors and Scales
abstract: arXiv:2605.28174v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Foundation models offer a promising route to transferable remote sensing representations, but many current approaches depend on very large pretraining datasets and fixed sensor configurations, limiting their suitability for ecological and environmental applications, where observations often vary across platforms, spatial and spectral resolutions, and available modalities. We introduce FLORO, a multimodal geospatial foundation model designed to learn transferable representations from a small but highly diverse remote sensing corpus. FLORO is pretrained using masked autoencoding on a heterogeneous combination of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, SkySAT imagery, elevation, and UAV-derived data. To accommodate sensor variability, FLORO incorporates availability-aware inputs that indicate which spectral bands and auxiliary modalities are present in each sample, enabling a unified input space across heterogeneous sensor configurations. translated_title: FLORO：一个跨传感器与尺度的生态遥感多模态地理空间基础模型
translated_abstract: 基础模型为学习可迁移的遥感表征提供了一条有前景的路径，但当前许多方法依赖于超大规模的预训练数据集和固定的传感器配置，这限制了它们在生态与环境应用中的适用性——因为这类应用中的观测数据往往在平台、空间和光谱分辨率以及可用模态上存在差异。我们提出了FLORO，这是一个多模态地理空间基础模型，旨在从小型但高度多样化的遥感语料库中学习可迁移的表征。FLORO采用掩码自编码方式进行预训练，训练数据由Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、SkySAT影像、高程数据以及无人机（UAV）衍生数据的异构组合构成。为了适应传感器的多样性，FLORO引入了可用性感知输入，用于指示每个样本中实际存在哪些光谱波段和辅助模态，从而在异构的传感器配置之间实现统一的输入空间。我们评估……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出多模态地理空间基础模型FLORO，通过可用性感知输入和掩码自编码，在小型但高度多样化的异构遥感语料库（Sentinel-1/2、SkySAT、高程与无人机数据）上预训练，实现跨传感器、跨分辨率的生态遥感可迁移表征学习。
en_tdlr: FLORO is a multimodal geospatial foundation model that uses availability-aware inputs and masked autoencoding to learn transferable ecological remote sensing representations from a small yet highly diverse corpus spanning heterogeneous sensors, resolutions, and modalities (Sentinel-1/2, SkySAT, elevation, and UAV data).
